description: Perspectives Gaz 2022 - Scénario de consommation de gaz à l'horizon 2050 is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Scénarios de consommation de gaz à horizon 2050 (Perspectives Gaz édition 2022) Ce jeu de données présente le scénario de référence de consommation de gaz en France à horizon 2050 présenté dans le document « Perspectives Gaz 2022 ». Coverage: France. The portal files it under Consommation. Its keywords are Consommation, GNV, mobilité gaz, projections, gaz, gaz naturel. The portal shows 2023-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
